pages.text: In the $(l)Danse Macabre$() the Afflicted and the Heralds carry something worse. The $(4)Rot$() weakens, sickens, and leaves a green stain in the air around the sick.$(br2)Beasts and villagers that reach its worst stage do not die: they $(4)turn$(), there and then. People and their tamed animals only suffer.$(br2)Only $(l)Theriac$() cures it.
